title: gentiana campestris subsp. baltica
intro: Gentiana campestris subsp. baltica, commonly known as Baltic gentian or gentian of the field, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the gentian family, characterized by its unique appearance and medicinal properties. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Baltic gentian include its ability to stimulate digestion, improve appetite, and relieve symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Baltic gentian include iridoids, gentiopicroside, and gentianose, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used in the production of herbal supplements and pharmaceuticals.
